Name: DEPRECATED - New NPC Mona
Author: Zilsara
Description:
[size=4]This version is DEPRECATED and not fully compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6 
A big thanks to silvermoonchan who made a 1.6 compatible version : https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43616[/size]

She currently[b] likes to read[/b] in the library, in the forest or on the beach depending on the season. She goes to the saloon every now and then and has a [b]job at the museum[/b], where she helps Gunther with the library. She will slowly open up about the war, her family and her life as a refugee.

You can now [b]date and marry[/b] Mona! With a lot of specific dialogue, a marriage schedule and even more incoming. She has an [b]optional spouse room[/b] in a separate file that works with TMXLoader from Platonymous. 

She is featured in [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4085?tab=description]The Perks of Being Married[/url] [/b]from TrentXV. If you download this mod, once married with her, Mona will get letters from her brother with little gifts inside.

Mona can attend the [b]festivals[/b]. You won't be able to dance with her at the flower dance though...

Mona [b]changes clothes depending on the season[/b]. Change to 'false' into config to deactivate feature. To change the default sprite just copy whichever one is your favorite and rename it to 'Mona' (remember to do it both into portraits and sprites).

[b]What's new[/b] :
[list]
[*]Finally fixed the conflict between SVE and Mona's festival locations
[*]Mona attends festivals (optional file, TMXLoader from Platonymous is needed)
[*]5, 8 and 10 hearts events
[/list]
[b]What's old[/b] :
[list]
[*]Added marriage schedule
[*]Optional spouse room (TMXLoader from Platonymous is needed)
[/list][list]
[*]2 hearts heart event
[*]Added marriage, marriage dialogue
[*]Added seasonal oufits !
[*]More dialogue with each update
[*]Added gift preference. Up to you to find what she likes and what she doesn't ! 
[/list]
- Still working on it so there might be a few bugs. Please let me know if you find anything or if you have suggestions.

[b]Guide of the Hearts Events [/b]:
[spoiler] [list]
[*]2 hearts :  at Haley and Emily's house, any time, any day
[*]5 hearts : at the beach, sunny weather, between 8am and 6pm, every day except winter
[*]8 hearts : at the Museum, sunny weather, between 12am and 6pm, every day except winter
[*]10 hearts : invitation by mail, starts at the bus stop, sunny weather, between 6am and 12am, every day except winter
[/list][/spoiler]

[b]Gift preference [/b]:
[spoiler][list]
[*]Love: Glazed yam, Spicy eel, Rainbow shell, Coconut
[*]Like: Fried eel, Nautilus shell, Coral, Cooking, Fruit, Forage
[*]Neutral: Vegetable
[*]Dislike: Rice pudding, Fish
[*]Hate: Salmon dinner, Fish taco, Crispy bass, Trout soup, Sashimi, Egg
[/list][/spoiler]

[b]Uninstall[/b]:
See Uninstallation Instructions on https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3732. Just replace "Shiko" with "Mona" of course.
